Title: Is Enhanced Coagulant still an equipment after a successful strike?

Messages.Author: the1andonlime
Messages.Body:
Is Enhanced Coagulation still an equipment after a successful strike?

If yes, is it still a Weapon, and does it still retain the strike ability?

Enhanced Coagulant Cost: 1 pool Type: Equipment Art: Ginés Quiñonero Weapon. Strike: 3 unpreventable damage and put this card on the opposing vampire; it becomes a card with "Cards requiring a Discipline cost this vampire +1 blood. After this vampire successfully hunts, burn this card.".

Suaku

Messages.Author: kschaefer
Messages.Body: No. The card text is changed when it is played on the opposing vampire.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> kschaefer wrote:
> No. The card text is changed when it is played on the opposing vampire.
>
Correct.
